functions.name: fetch_bible_chapter
functions.title: Fetch Bible Chapter
functions.description: Fetches Amharic Bible verses for a given book and chapter from the in-app Bible reader dataset. Use when the user asks to read or quote an Amharic Bible passage. Pass `file` as the book's JSON filename (e.g. "01_Genesis.json", "42_Luke.json") and `chapter` as a 1-based chapter number (defaults to 1).

functions.name: search_mezmur_lyrics
functions.title: Search Mezmur Lyrics
functions.description: Searches the web for Ethiopian mezmur (Orthodox church song) lyrics by query. Use when the user asks to find lyrics for a mezmur or church song. Pass `query` (Amharic or English song title or phrase, max 120 characters).

query.description: Song title or phrase to search, max 120 characters

functions.name: send_telegram_message
functions.title: Send Telegram Message
functions.description: Posts a message to the choir's Telegram group. Use when the user asks to send an announcement, notice, or reminder to the choir Telegram group. Pass `text` (the message body; HTML formatting allowed). Telegram bot credentials are configured server-side.

text.description: Message text to send to the choir Telegram group

parse_mode.description: Telegram parse mode, defaults to HTML

functions.name: transcribe_voice_note
functions.title: Transcribe Voice Note
functions.description: Transcribes an uploaded audio voice note to text. Use when the user asks to transcribe a voice note. Pass `audio_url` (public URL of the audio file) and optionally `note_id` to update an existing VoiceNote record with the transcript.

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio file to transcribe

note_id.description: Optional VoiceNote record ID to update with the transcript
